key: ...So my roommate said she was gonna convert our place into a streamer house.
en: ...So my roommate said she was gonna convert our place into a streamer house.
ja: ……それでルームメイトが、うちを配信者ハウスに改装するって言い出してさ。

key: Naturally, I thought she meant online streaming.
en: Naturally, I thought she meant online streaming.
ja: てっきり、ネット配信のことだと思ったんだよね。

key: In retrospect, this was foolish of me.
en: In retrospect, this was foolish of me.
ja: 今思えば、浅はかだったよ。

key: Sandy, what the hell...
en: Sandy, what the hell...
ja: サンディ、一体何なんだよ……

key: Welcome! This is the meeting place of Reborn's Geography Club! Fascinating, is it not?
en: Welcome! This is the meeting place of Reborn's Geography Club! Fascinating, is it not?
ja: ようこそ! ここはリボーン地理クラブの集会所です! 興味深いでしょう?

key: Welcome! This is the meeting place of Reborn's History Club! Isn't it wonderful?
en: Welcome! This is the meeting place of Reborn's History Club! Isn't it wonderful?
ja: ようこそ! ここはリボーン歴史クラブの集会所です! 素晴らしいと思いませんか?

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Opal Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Opal Ward?
ja: こんにちは! オパールワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: The Opal Ward is right in the heart of Reborn City! It's one of the busiest wards, often bustling with Trainers and pedestrians alike!
en: The Opal Ward is right in the heart of Reborn City! It's one of the busiest wards, often bustling with Trainers and pedestrians alike!
ja: オパールワードは、リボーンシティのまさに中心部です! 最もにぎわうワードのひとつで、トレーナーも通行人も、いつも行き交っています!

key: Opal Bridge, the walkway between the lower-level of the ward and the Obsidia Ward in itself, is a renowned battling location!
en: Opal Bridge, the walkway between the lower-level of the ward and the Obsidia Ward in itself, is a renowned battling location!
ja: このワードの下層とオブシディアワードを結ぶ通路、オパール大橋は、バトルの名所として知られています!

key: New Trainers show up there for challenges all the time, so always be on your guard!
en: New Trainers show up there for challenges all the time, so always be on your guard!
ja: 新人トレーナーが挑戦しに来ることもしょっちゅうなので、いつも油断しないように!

key: Of course, should you need to heal, simply stroll down to the Grand Hall! One of the largest buildings in Reborn, and the only one in Opal!
en: Of course, should you need to heal, simply stroll down to the Grand Hall! One of the largest buildings in Reborn, and the only one in Opal!
ja: もちろん、回復が必要なら、大ホールまで歩いていけば大丈夫! リボーンでも最大級の建物で、オパールにあるのはあそこだけです!

key: The Grand Hall has its own center, mart, and is generally a hub for the Reborn League. 'Tis a great place!
en: The Grand Hall has its own center, mart, and is generally a hub for the Reborn League. 'Tis a great place!
ja: 大ホールには、専用のポケモンセンターとショップがあって、リボーンリーグの拠点にもなっています。素晴らしい場所ですよ!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Obsidia Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Obsidia Ward?
ja: こんにちは! オブシディアワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: The Obsidia Ward is Reborn's largest ward, oftentimes considered in two separate halves, the main and south area, and North Obsidia.
en: The Obsidia Ward is Reborn's largest ward, oftentimes considered in two separate halves, the main and south area, and North Obsidia.
ja: オブシディアワードは、リボーン最大のワードで、しばしば二つの区域に分けて考えられます。中心部と南側の区域、そして北オブシディアです。

key: Of course, we're in North Obsidia now, but the two halves have even been cut off from each other after the recent earthquakes. Oh my!
en: Of course, we're in North Obsidia now, but the two halves have even been cut off from each other after the recent earthquakes. Oh my!
ja: もちろん、今わたしたちがいるのは北オブシディアですが、先日の地震で、二つの区域は互いに分断されてしまいました。まあ大変!

key: After all, underneath the Obsidia Ward is a network of railway tunnels. When the earthquakes hit, the hollow foundation gave way!
en: After all, underneath the Obsidia Ward is a network of railway tunnels. When the earthquakes hit, the hollow foundation gave way!
ja: というのも、オブシディアワードの地下には鉄道トンネルの網が広がっていて、地震が起きたとき、その空洞になった地盤が崩れてしまったのです!

key: Not only is the tunnel unusable, but much of the ward was destroyed, including the HQ of Reborn's largest company, Yureyu!
en: Not only is the tunnel unusable, but much of the ward was destroyed, including the HQ of Reborn's largest company, Yureyu!
ja: トンネルが使えなくなっただけでなく、ワードの大部分が破壊され、リボーン最大の企業、ユレユの本部までもが被害を受けました!

key: While North Obsidia features the massive Grand Stairway, a monument leading outside the city,
en: While North Obsidia features the massive Grand Stairway, a monument leading outside the city,
ja: 北オブシディアには、街の外へと続く巨大な記念碑、大階段がありますが、

key: Central Obsidia is now the prime commercial district. There are salons, shops, and even a beautiful park all along Main Street!
en: Central Obsidia is now the prime commercial district.  There are salons, shops, and even a beautiful park all along Main Street!
ja: 中央オブシディアは、今では一大商業地区となっています。メイン通り沿いには、サロンやお店、それに美しい公園まであるんですよ!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Onyx Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Onyx Ward?
ja: こんにちは! オニキスワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: The Onyx Ward is one of the finest residential wards in the city. This may perhaps be because of its close location to the Onyx Trainers' School!
en: The Onyx Ward is one of the finest residential wards in the city. This may perhaps be because of its close location to the Onyx Trainers' School!
ja: オニキスワードは、街の中でも指折りの高級住宅ワードです。それはもしかすると、オニキストレーナー学校が近くにあるからかもしれません!

key: More than just a school, it also doubles as a Reborn League Gym! Young Trainers of all kinds flock there for their own reasons!
en: More than just a school, it also doubles as a Reborn League Gym! Young Trainers of all kinds flock there for their own reasons!
ja: ただの学校というだけでなく、リボーンリーグのジムも兼ねているんです! さまざまな若いトレーナーたちが、それぞれの理由でそこに集まってきます!

key: Between that and the Onyx Arcade, the Onyx Ward is one of the most youthful and lively places in the city!
en: Between that and the Onyx Arcade, the Onyx Ward is one of the most youthful and lively places in the city!
ja: それとオニキスゲームセンターのおかげで、オニキスワードは街の中でも特に若々しく活気のある場所になっています!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Peridot Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Peridot Ward?
ja: こんにちは! ペリドットワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: The Peridot Ward is the second largest in the city! More than any other, however, it's also primarily an industrial ward.
en: The Peridot Ward is the second largest in the city!  More than any other, however, it's also primarily an industrial ward.
ja: ペリドットワードは、街で二番目に大きなワードです! ただ、他のどこよりも、主に工業地帯としての性格が強いんです。

key: Factories and warehouses line its shores of Azurine Lake... Many lower-income people live there too!
en: Factories and warehouses line its shores of Azurine Lake... Many lower-income people live there too!
ja: アズリン湖の岸沿いには、工場や倉庫が立ち並んでいて……低所得の方々も多く住んでいます!

key: Unfortunately, as a result, the Peridot Ward has become notorious for homelessness and gang activity...
en: Unfortunately, as a result, the Peridot Ward has become notorious for homelessness and gang activity...
ja: 残念ながらその結果、ペリドットワードはホームレスとギャング活動で悪名高くなってしまいました……

key: On a lighter note, the Power Plant and Reborn League Gym is also located there, not far from the Peridot Station, the best way in and out of Reborn!
en: On a lighter note, the Power Plant and Reborn League Gym is also located there, not far from the Peridot Station, the best way in and out of Reborn!
ja: 明るい話をすると、発電所とリボーンリーグのジムもそこにあって、リボーンへの最良の出入り口であるペリドット駅からもそう遠くありません!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Jasper Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Jasper Ward?
ja: こんにちは! ジャスパーワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: Bordering the peaceful Malchous Forest, the Jasper Ward is a very moderate residential area.
en: Bordering the peaceful Malchous Forest, the Jasper Ward is a very moderate residential area.
ja: 穏やかなマルコウス森林公園に隣接するジャスパーワードは、とても落ち着いた住宅地です。

key: Many families of middle class live there- or... I should correct, did until quite recently...
en: Many families of middle class live there- or... I should correct, did until quite recently...
ja: 中流階級の家族が多く暮らしていますが――いえ、訂正します、つい最近までは、そうでした……

key: With the recent overexpansion of the Malchous Forest, Jasper has become somewhat of a ruin, sadly...
en: With the recent overexpansion of the Malchous Forest, Jasper has become somewhat of a ruin, sadly...
ja: 最近のマルコウス森林公園の異常な拡大によって、悲しいことに、ジャスパーはいくらか廃きょのようになってしまいました……

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Lapis Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Lapis Ward?
ja: こんにちは! ラピスワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: The Lapis Ward is one of the highest-class in Reborn!
en: The Lapis Ward is one of the highest-class in Reborn!
ja: ラピスワードは、リボーンでも指折りの高級ワードです!

key: Perhaps rivaled only by the Onyx Ward, it's an ideal place for a family, with some of the lowest crime rates in the city!
en: Perhaps rivaled only by the Onyx Ward, it's an ideal place for a family, with some of the lowest crime rates in the city!
ja: 匹敵するのはおそらくオニキスワードくらいで、街の中でも屈指の低い犯罪率を誇る、家族向けの理想的な場所です!

key: It's also one of the few locations unaffected by recent disasters...
en: It's also one of the few locations unaffected by recent disasters...
ja: それに、最近の災害の影響をほとんど受けていない、数少ない場所のひとつでもあります……

key: Most notable in the Lapis Ward are a Reborn League Gym and Dr. Connal's Orphanage. You can hardly miss them!
en: Most notable in the Lapis Ward are a Reborn League Gym and Dr. Connal's Orphanage. You can hardly miss them!
ja: ラピスワードで特に目を引くのは、リボーンリーグのジムと、コナル博士の孤児院です。見逃すことはまずないでしょう!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Beryl Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Beryl Ward?
ja: こんにちは! ベリルワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: Bordering the Rhodochrine Jungle, the Beryl Ward is among the larger wards in Reborn.
en: Bordering the Rhodochrine Jungle, the Beryl Ward is among the larger wards in Reborn.
ja: ロドクラインジャングルに隣接するベリルワードは、リボーンでも大きめのワードのひとつです。

key: Although the recent disaster has spelled an end for much of its residence, Beryl was formerly a very unique middle-class community.
en: Although the recent disaster has spelled an end for much of its residence, Beryl was formerly a very unique middle-class community.
ja: 最近の災害で住民の多くが去ることになりましたが、ベリルはかつて、とても個性的な中流階級のコミュニティでした。

key: It also held a reputation of being one of the sightseeing places in the city, as it is the highest-up ward!
en: It also held a reputation of being one of the sightseeing places in the city, as it is the highest-up ward!
ja: 街で最も標高の高いワードということもあり、観光地のひとつとしても評判でした!

key: It offers great views of the Tourmaline Desert, Reborn City, and even the Azurine Region!
en: It offers great views of the Tourmaline Desert, Reborn City, and even the Azurine Region!
ja: トルマリン砂漠やリボーンシティ、それにアズリン地方までも見渡せる、すばらしい景色が広がっています!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Coral Ward?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Coral Ward?
ja: こんにちは! コーラルワードについて聞きたいですか?

key: The Coral Ward is the smallest ward of Reborn, tucked into the corner of the Azurine Lake near South Obsidia.
en: The Coral Ward is the smallest ward of Reborn, tucked into the corner of the Azurine Lake near South Obsidia.
ja: コーラルワードは、リボーンで最も小さなワードで、南オブシディアの近く、アズリン湖の一角にひっそりと位置しています。

key: Its main attraction has been its port! Coral is normally a very lively location full of hard workers and tourists traveling the lake!
en: Its main attraction has been its port! Coral is normally a very lively location full of hard workers and tourists traveling the lake!
ja: 一番の見どころは港です! 普段のコーラルは、働き者や湖を旅する観光客であふれる、とても活気のある場所なんです!

key: Unfortunately, thanks to the recent water quality, there's been little need to go down there...
en: Unfortunately, thanks to the recent water quality, there's been little need to go down there...
ja: 残念ながら、最近の水質のせいで、そこまで足を運ぶ理由もほとんどなくなってしまいました……

key: Interested in learning about Reborn's geography! Splendid!
en: Interested in learning about Reborn's geography!  Splendid!
ja: リボーンの地理に興味があるんですね! 素晴らしい!

key: I'll give you one quick tip! Often times we refer to places, for instance the Azurine Region, just so, with the word 'Region'.
en: I'll give you one quick tip! Often times we refer to places, for instance the Azurine Region, just so, with the word 'Region'.
ja: ちょっとしたコツをひとつ教えましょう! 例えばアズリン地方のように、「地方」という言葉をそのまま使って場所を呼ぶことがよくあります。

key: While it may be confusing to some, this use of the word 'Region' varies from that of places like the Hoenn Region, Kanto Region, or Reborn Region.
en: While it may be confusing to some, this use of the word 'Region' varies from that of places like the Hoenn Region, Kanto Region, or Reborn Region.
ja: 混乱する人もいるかもしれませんが、この「地方」という言葉の使い方は、ホウエン地方やカントー地方、リボーン地方のような場所とは、少し意味合いが違うんです。

key: When we talk about regions here, think of them more as sub-regions, as they are all places within the greater Reborn Region!
en: When we talk about regions here, think of them more as sub-regions, as they are all places within the greater Reborn Region!
ja: ここで言う「地方」は、いわば地域区分のようなものだと考えてください。すべて、より大きなリボーン地方の中にある場所ですから!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Chrysolia Region?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Chrysolia Region?
ja: こんにちは! クリソリア地方について聞きたいですか?

key: Much of Chrysolia is an old forest, formerly connecting Reborn City and the Orre Region!
en: Much of Chrysolia is an old forest, formerly connecting Reborn City and the Orre Region!
ja: クリソリアの大部分は古い森で、かつてはリボーンシティとオーレ地方を結んでいました!

key: Other landmarks include the quaint Spinel Town, and the Tanzan Mountain area, a network of sprawing trails and caves!
en: Other landmarks include the quaint Spinel Town, and the Tanzan Mountain area, a network of sprawing trails and caves!
ja: 他にも、趣のあるスピネルタウンや、入り組んだ小道と洞窟が広がるタンザン山一帯などが名所です!

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Azurine Region?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Azurine Region?
ja: こんにちは! アズリン地方について聞きたいですか?

key: The Azurine Region lies across Azurine Lake from Reborn City!
en: The Azurine Region lies across Azurine Lake from Reborn City!
ja: アズリン地方は、リボーンシティからアズリン湖を挟んだ向こう側にあります!

key: Full of beaches and mountains, it's quite an empty place, speaking in terms of the locals. In fact, there's only one settlement there!
en: Full of beaches and mountains, it's quite an empty place, speaking in terms of the locals. In fact, there's only one settlement there!
ja: ビーチや山に恵まれていますが、地元の人に言わせるとかなりの田舎で、実際、集落はひとつしかありません!

key: On the Apophyll Beach, there is a small Academy! Sometimes Trainers who wish not to study in the city will go there instead.
en: On the Apophyll Beach, there is a small Academy!  Sometimes Trainers who wish not to study in the city will go there instead.
ja: アポフィルビーチには、小さな学園があります! 街で学びたくないトレーナーが、代わりにそこへ通うこともあります。

key: There is also an island not far off, known as Azurine Island. Little is known about it...
en: There is also an island not far off, known as Azurine Island. Little is known about it...
ja: そう遠くない場所には、アズリン島として知られる島もあります。その島についてはほとんど知られていません……

key: Finally, a massive volcano, known as Pyrous Mountain, towers above the area, shedding a layer of ash across it...
en: Finally, a massive volcano, known as Pyrous Mountain, towers above the area, shedding a layer of ash across it...
ja: 最後に、パイロス山として知られる巨大な火山が、その一帯にそびえ立ち、辺り一面に灰を降らせています……

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Byxbysion Wasteland?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Byxbysion Wasteland?
ja: こんにちは! ビクスビジョン荒地について聞きたいですか?

key: The Byxbysion Wasteland is a treacherous jumble of debris that surrounds the entire southern border of the Reborn Region.
en: The Byxbysion Wasteland is a treacherous jumble of debris that surrounds the entire southern border of the Reborn Region.
ja: ビクスビジョン荒地は、リボーン地方の南の境界全体を取り囲む、危険ながれきの山です。

key: Those who venture far out into it seldom return, so little is known about it...
en: Those who venture far out into it seldom return, so little is known about it...
ja: 奥深くまで足を踏み入れた者はめったに戻ってこないため、あまり多くのことはわかっていません……

key: But whispers of discovered ruins and objects suggest perhaps there was once something else beneath the filth...
en: But whispers of discovered ruins and objects suggest perhaps there was once something else beneath the filth...
ja: ですが、発見された遺跡や物品にまつわるうわさは、あの汚泥の下にかつて何か別のものがあったことを示唆しています……

key: Something from a story since passed and forgotten... Orre it could simply be a rumor...
en: Something from a story since passed and forgotten...  Orre it could simply be a rumor...
ja: 語り継がれず、忘れ去られた物語からの何か……あるいは、単なるうわさにすぎないのかもしれません……

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Aventurine Region?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Aventurine Region?
ja: こんにちは! アベンチュリン地方について聞きたいですか?

key: The Aventurine Region lies just north of here, through the Grand Gates!
en: The Aventurine Region lies just north of here, through the Grand Gates!
ja: アベンチュリン地方は、ここからすぐ北、大門を抜けた先にあります!

key: On the whole, it's one of the most beautiful places in Reborn, with lush forests, rich peaks, and even a special crystal valley...
en: On the whole, it's one of the most beautiful places in Reborn, with lush forests, rich peaks, and even a special crystal valley...
ja: 全体として、リボーンでも最も美しい場所のひとつで、豊かな森、豊かな山々、それに特別な結晶の谷まであります……

key: Also around are the Celestinine River, the famous Agate Circus, and Agate City with a history older than it belies... As well as a mysterious castle...
en: Also around are the Celestinine River, the famous Agate Circus, and Agate City with a history older than it belies... As well as a mysterious castle...
ja: 他にも、セレスティナイン川、有名なアゲートサーカス、そして見た目以上に古い歴史を持つアゲートシティ……それに、謎めいた城もあります……

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Tourmaline Desert?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Tourmaline Desert?
ja: こんにちは! トルマリン砂漠について聞きたいですか?

key: The Tourmaline Desert reaches for miles, bordering the northern end of the Reborn Region!
en: The Tourmaline Desert reaches for miles, bordering the northern end of the Reborn Region!
ja: トルマリン砂漠は、リボーン地方の北の果てに広がる、何マイルにも及ぶ砂漠です!

key: Many newcomers travel via train across the desert from very far away. What those Trainers don't know is the desert's mysterious history!
en: Many newcomers travel via train across the desert from very far away. What those Trainers don't know is the desert's mysterious history!
ja: 多くの新参者が、遠方から列車で砂漠を横断してやってきます。そんなトレーナーたちが知らないのは、この砂漠の不思議な歴史です!

key: The train tracks have had to been rebuilt several times, thanks to a multitude of strange accidents...
en: The train tracks have had to been rebuilt several times, thanks to a multitude of strange accidents...
ja: 数々の奇妙な事故のせいで、線路は何度も作り直されてきました……

key: As a result, a strange scrapyard of train parts rests out in the middle of the desert...
en: As a result, a strange scrapyard of train parts rests out in the middle of the desert...
ja: その結果、砂漠のど真ん中には、奇妙な列車部品の廃棄場が残されています……

key: Sometimes, it even stands in the shadow of an enormous tower... But as soon as you blink- the tower vanishes! How curious...
en: Sometimes, it even stands in the shadow of an enormous tower... But as soon as you blink- the tower vanishes! How curious...
ja: 時にはそこに、巨大な塔の影が差すこともあります……でも瞬きした瞬間、その塔は消えてしまうんです! 何とも不思議な話ですね……

key: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Carnelia Region?
en: Hello! Would you like to hear about the Carnelia Region?
ja: こんにちは! カルネリア地方について聞きたいですか?

key: The Carnelia Region is home to the twin cities of Calcenon and Labradorra! They rest in the valley of some of the tallest mountains in Reborn!
en: The Carnelia Region is home to the twin cities of Calcenon and Labradorra! They rest in the valley of some of the tallest mountains in Reborn!
ja: カルネリア地方は、双子都市カルセノンとラブラドラの故郷です! リボーンでも屈指の高山に囲まれた谷間に位置しています!

key: Though all topped with icy peaks, the largest by far is Ametrine Mountain! It overshadows even the most important Charous Mountain...
en: Though all topped with icy peaks, the largest by far is Ametrine Mountain! It overshadows even the most important Charous Mountain...
ja: どの峰も氷に覆われた頂を持っていますが、その中でも群を抜いて大きいのがアメトリン山です! 最も重要なシャルース山さえも、その陰に隠れてしまうほどで……

key: ...where the Reborn League Champion waits...
en: ...where the Reborn League Champion waits...
ja: ……そこには、リボーンリーグのチャンピオンが待っています……

key: Uh...
en: Uh...
ja: えっと……

key: Oh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.
en: Oh, yes, I'm the Move Deleter.
ja: おお、そうそう、わたしはわざわすれ屋じゃ。

key: I can make Pokémon forget their moves.
en: I can make Pokémon forget their moves.
ja: ポケモンのわざを、わすれさせることができるんじゃよ。

key: Would you like me to do that?
en: Would you like me to do that?
ja: そうしてほしいかね?

key: Which Pokémon should forget a move?
en: Which Pokémon should forget a move?
ja: どのポケモンにわざをわすれさせる?

key: Come again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
en: Come again if there are moves that need to be forgotten.
ja: わすれさせたいわざがあったら、また来るんじゃぞ。

key: What? No Egg should know any moves.
en: What?  No Egg should know any moves.
ja: なんじゃ? タマゴはわざを覚えていないはずじゃが。

key: What? I can't make Shadow Pokémon forget a move.
en: What?  I can't make Shadow Pokémon forget a move.
ja: なんじゃ? シャドウポケモンのわざは、わすれさせられんのう。

key: \v[3] seems to know only one move...
en: \v[3] seems to know only one move...
ja: \v[3]はわざをひとつしかおぼえていないようじゃ……

key: Which move should be forgotten?
en: Which move should be forgotten?
ja: どのわざをわすれさせる?

key: Hm! \v[3]'s \v[4]? That move should be forgotten?
en: Hm!  \v[3]'s \v[4]?  That move should be forgotten?
ja: ふむ! \v[3]の「\v[4]」じゃな? そのわざをわすれさせるんじゃな?

key: It worked to perfection!
en: It worked to perfection!
ja: みごと成功じゃ!

key: \v[3] has forgotten \v[4] completely.
en: \v[3] has forgotten \v[4] completely.
ja: \v[3]は「\v[4]」をきれいさっぱりわすれた。

key: COREY: ...
en: COREY: ...
ja: コーリー: ……

key: ZORUA: Zorrrrrrrrrrr!
en: ZORUA: Zorrrrrrrrrrr!
ja: ゾロア: ゾロァァァァァァ!

key: ARC: Knock knock, Dad.
en: ARC: Knock knock, Dad.
ja: アーク: ノックノック、父さん。

key: You've got company.
en: You've got company.
ja: お客さんだよ。

key: DAD: Oh, my boy, it's so good to see you!
en: DAD: Oh, my boy, it's so good to see you!
ja: パパ: おお、我が息子よ、会えてうれしいぞ!

key: Come in, come in!
en: Come in, come in!
ja: 入れ、入れ!

key: ARC: ...Seriously, Dad?
en: ARC: ...Seriously, Dad?
ja: アーク: ……マジかよ、父さん。

key: This place is a mess.
en: This place is a mess.
ja: 部屋、散らかりすぎだろ。

key: DAD: Ahh, I've been so busy lately, you know how it is?
en: DAD: Ahh, I've been so busy lately, you know how it is?
ja: パパ: ああ、最近忙しくてな、わかるだろう?

key: ARC: I do know how it is.
en: ARC: I do know how it is.
ja: アーク: わかるよ。

key: Do better.
en: Do better.
ja: もっとちゃんとしてくれよ。

key: ARC: Sorry, \PN, just give me a sec.
en: ARC: Sorry, \PN, just give me a sec.
ja: アーク: ごめん\PN、ちょっと待ってて。

key: Make yourself at home.
en: Make yourself at home.
ja: くつろいでて。

key: DAD: Aren't you going to introduce me to your friend?
en: DAD: Aren't you going to introduce me to your friend?
ja: パパ: お友達を紹介してくれないのか?

key: ARC: Right, so, Dad, this is \PN.
en: ARC: Right, so, Dad, this is \PN.
ja: アーク: そうだ、父さん、こちらは\PN。

key: He's the Champion.
en: He's the Champion.
ja: チャンピオンなんだ。

key: She's the Champion.
en: She's the Champion.
ja: チャンピオンなんだ。

key: They're the Champion.
en: They're the Champion.
ja: チャンピオンなんだ。

key: DAD: The Champion?!
en: DAD: The Champion?!
ja: パパ: チャンピオン?!

key: You are running in high places!
en: You are running in high places!
ja: ずいぶんと大した所に出入りしてるんだな!

key: You did not tell me you were meeting with the Champion!
en: You did not tell me you were meeting with the Champion!
ja: チャンピオンと会うなんて、聞いてなかったぞ!

key: ARC: There's a lot I haven't told you.
en: ARC: There's a lot I haven't told you.
ja: アーク: 話してないこと、たくさんあるからね。

key: Stuff was busy for a while.
en: Stuff was busy for a while.
ja: しばらく色々忙しかったんだ。

key: But, that's part of why I wanted to drop by.
en: But, that's part of why I wanted to drop by.
ja: でも、それもあって寄りたかったんだよ。

key: Say "Hi" to Mom, let you know I'm safe...
en: Say "Hi" to Mom, let you know I'm safe...
ja: 母さんによろしくって、あと自分が無事だってことも伝えたくて……

key: Everything's good.
en: Everything's good.
ja: 何もかも順調だから。

key: DAD: That is very good to hear...
en: DAD: That is very good to hear...
ja: パパ: それは何よりだ……

key: ARC: Also, Jay said you were asking him for money again.
en: ARC: Also, Jay said you were asking him for money again.
ja: アーク: それと、ジェイが、また父さんにお金を無心されたって言ってたよ。

key: DAD: Ohhhhh no, no no no, I told your brother not to bother you with that--
en: DAD: Ohhhhh no, no no no, I told your brother not to bother you with that--
ja: パパ: いやいやいや、そんな、お前の兄さんには、それでお前に迷惑をかけるなと言ったのに――

key: ARC: Dad,
en: ARC: Dad,
ja: アーク: 父さん、

key: DAD: You don't have to worry about it, you've done enough already--
en: DAD: You don't have to worry about it, you've done enough already--
ja: パパ: 心配しなくていい、お前にはもう十分してもらってるんだから――

key: ARC: Dad, listen.
en: ARC: Dad, listen.
ja: アーク: 父さん、聞いて。

key: If you need money, you come to me.
en: If you need money, you come to me.
ja: お金が必要なら、僕のところに来て。

key: Not him,
en: Not him,
ja: 兄さんじゃなくて、

key: Me.
en: Me.
ja: 僕に。

key: Understand?
en: Understand?
ja: わかった?

key: DAD: Yes, yes, yes, it was just a minor thing--
en: DAD: Yes, yes, yes, it was just a minor thing--
ja: パパ: ああ、ああ、わかった、ちょっとしたことだったんだが――

key: ARC: Even for minor things, you come to me.
en: ARC: Even for minor things, you come to me.
ja: アーク: ちょっとしたことでも、僕のところに来て。

key: He needs to be free to stand on his own.
en: He needs to be free to stand on his own.
ja: 兄さんには、自分の足で立つ自由が必要なんだ。

key: Are we clear?
en: Are we clear?
ja: わかった?

key: DAD: Yes, yes, yes...
en: DAD: Yes, yes, yes...
ja: パパ: ああ、ああ、わかった……

key: We are clear.
en: We are clear.
ja: わかったとも。

key: ARC: Good.
en: ARC: Good.
ja: アーク: よし。

key: ARC: Here's for this month.
en: ARC: Here's for this month.
ja: アーク: 今月の分、これ。

key: There's a little extra, because Mom mentioned something about the sink.
en: There's a little extra, because Mom mentioned something about the sink.
ja: ちょっと多めに入れといた、母さんがシンクのこと何か言ってたから。

key: DAD: Oh... Yes, yes, thank you.
en: DAD: Oh... Yes, yes, thank you.
ja: パパ: ああ……そうか、そうか、ありがとう。

key: I-- I don't know what we'd do without you.
en: I-- I don't know what we'd do without you.
ja: お前がいなかったら、一体どうなっていたことか。

key: ARC: I know.
en: ARC: I know.
ja: アーク: わかってるよ。

key: How's Mom?
en: How's Mom?
ja: 母さんの調子は?

key: DAD: The usual...
en: DAD: The usual...
ja: パパ: いつも通りだ……

key: Same as usual.
en: Same as usual.
ja: いつもと変わらない。

key: She's sleeping right now, but I'm sure she won't mind if you say "Hi".
en: She's sleeping right now, but I'm sure she won't mind if you say "Hi".
ja: 今は眠っているが、お前が声をかけても嫌がらないだろう。

key: ARC: I'll do that.
en: ARC: I'll do that.
ja: アーク: そうするよ。

key: ARC: Come with me.
en: ARC: Come with me.
ja: アーク: ついてきて。

key: Sorry about that.
en: Sorry about that.
ja: さっきはごめん。

key: ARC: She's had a hard time.
en: ARC: She's had a hard time.
ja: アーク: 母さん、大変な時期を過ごしてるんだ。

key: I won't bore you with the details, but...
en: I won't bore you with the details, but...
ja: 詳しい話で退屈させたくはないけど……

key: This is how she spends most of her time.
en: This is how she spends most of her time.
ja: これが、母さんの大半の時間の過ごし方なんだ。

key: ARC: I just wanted you to see.
en: ARC: I just wanted you to see.
ja: アーク: ただ、見ておいてほしかったんだ。

key: Like I said, we gotta work hard to take care of those close to us.
en: Like I said, we gotta work hard to take care of those close to us.
ja: 前にも言ったけど、身近な人を大事にするには、頑張らなきゃいけないからね。

key: ARC: Hey, Mom.
en: ARC: Hey, Mom.
ja: アーク: ねえ、母さん。

key: We've got a visitor.
en: We've got a visitor.
ja: お客さんが来てるよ。

key: ARC: So... we took care of the situation I told you about last time.
en: ARC: So... we took care of the situation I told you about last time.
ja: アーク: それで……前に話してた件、片づいたんだ。

key: Or, \PN did.
en: Or, \PN did.
ja: というか、\PNがね。

key: Now it's about clean up and getting back on track.
en: Now it's about clean up and getting back on track.
ja: あとは後片づけをして、軌道に戻すだけだよ。

key: I've been working with a group of guys lately.
en: I've been working with a group of guys lately.
ja: 最近、ある連中と一緒にやっててさ。

key: Used to be called the Magma Gang, but they're putting that behind them.
en: Used to be called the Magma Gang, but they're putting that behind them.
ja: 昔はマグマ団って呼ばれてたけど、もうそれは過去のことにしようとしてるんだ。

key: Used to be called the Aqua Gang, but they're putting that behind them.
en: Used to be called the Aqua Gang, but they're putting that behind them.
ja: 昔はアクア団って呼ばれてたけど、もうそれは過去のことにしようとしてるんだ。

key: They're a good bunch.
en: They're a good bunch.
ja: いい連中だよ。

key: Spirited.
en: Spirited.
ja: 元気いっぱいさ。

key: So, we ran across this urban camper the other day, and he didn't wanna move, because of course not.
en: So, we ran across this urban camper the other day, and he didn't wanna move, because of course not.
ja: それで先日、路上で暮らしてる人に出くわしてさ、案の定、動こうとしなかったんだ。

key: There was the usual argument about shelters, but then one of the guys brought up, "Who actually owns the space he's camping on?"
en: There was the usual argument about shelters, but then one of the guys brought up, "Who actually owns the space he's camping on?"
ja: 避難所についていつもの押し問答になったんだけど、そのとき仲間の一人が「そもそも、あいつがキャンプしてる場所って誰の土地なんだ?」って言い出して。

key: "Who's permission do we need?"
en: "Who's permission do we need?"
ja: 「誰の許可が要るんだ?」

key: So we did some digging, and you wouldn't believe who it turned out to be...
en: So we did some digging, and you wouldn't believe who it turned out to be...
ja: それで色々調べてみたら、驚くようなことがわかったんだ……

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
